summary.text: Priscilla Prado is a Democratic member of the Wisconsin State Assembly who has represented District 9 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026, general election.
An accountant, she owns a tax and bookkeeping firm.

paragraphs.text: Priscilla Prado was born in Los Angeles, California, and attended Milwaukee Area Technical College and Alverno College.
Her career experience includes working as an accountant and office administrator and owning a tax and bookkeeping firm, and she served on the board of the Wisconsin Latino Chamber of Commerce.
In a 2024 Ballotpedia survey, Prado said she was a mother of four with more than 22 years of accounting experience who ran a firm called Midwest Bookkeeping.
Prado took office on January 6, 2025, succeeding Democrat Marisabel Cabrera in District 9, and serves on the Commerce, State and Federal Relations, and Information Policy and Technology committees.
In the same 2024 survey she listed community-centered policy and representation, support for small businesses, and equity, safety and access to essential services as her key campaign messages.
